plan.name: 10-Week Strength & Conditioning (Power Clean / Bench)
plan.description: Post-V26.9 transition program for a 45-year-old with managed tennis elbow and goose-foot knee. M/W/F lifting with the Olympic lifts and bench, Tue/Thu conditioning. 3 phases: accumulation & tendon prep (1-4), intensification (5-8), deload + heavy realization (9-10). Loads ride below Monday-relative bench/back-squat ceilings; all percentages cap at the rule-defined RPE floor/ceiling.
plan.author: Power Clean / Bench Plan

programRules.boxSquatHLM: Box Squat top set ~5 kg below the same-week Friday Back Squat top set

concurrentFatigue.weeks5to8: Tue harder intervals / Thu Z1-2 only

programRules.compressionGoal: Mon parallette L-Sit + Friday Pike Pulses + 2 sets best-variation L-Sit hold (8-15 s)

exercises.notes: 3-5 min light spin to raise core temp

exerciseTemplates.notes: Power Primer Rule: 2-3 rounds x 3 plyo push-ups (handles or elevated). CNS prime before bench. Sub: med-ball chest pass if elbow > 2/10. Skip if elbow > 2/10.
Slow and controlled - immediately before first loaded Bench set
Straight-bar Bench (only non-neutral grip press). 2-second eccentric. Stop set if bar speed drops or positions break.
Bodyweight through Week 6 unless elbows are fully calm and reps stay crisp (Ring Pull-Up Split Progression Rule). Ring variation lets wrists rotate naturally.
Compression-Goal Rule (Monday). Tucked progressions Phase 1; one-leg / straddle Phase 2; full L-sit work Phase 3.
4 min: accumulate 16-20 crisp Ring Rows (rigid body line, 2-second chest-to-rings squeeze). Stop early if positions break.
Hook grip (elbow management). Vertical bar path, smooth pulls, no grinding. Convert to Clean Pulls if catches get sloppy or slow.
Explosive extension ABOVE knee; finish tall. Positional/technical reinforcement.
Variation Dose Rule: Friday clean variation is a TECHNICAL PRIMER. Fast, sharp reps only. Stop the set if turnover slows.
Hook grip. Full power clean from floor. Convert to Clean Pulls if positions break.
Box at exactly parallel (~41-43 cm). True 1-second dead stop on box, no rocking. HLM rule: load stays ~5 kg below same-week Back Squat top set. 2.5-3 min rest in Wks 7-10.
Tripod foot, knees track over toes. 1-second pause at depth (Phases 1-2). If knees irritated, drop 5 kg from listed load.
Hinge Rule: shins vertical, 3-0-1-0 tempo. Stop at deepest pain-free hamstring position. Loads ~40-55% of 155 kg DL.
Phase 1: 20-25 kg/hand build. Phase 2: 25-30 kg/hand. Wks 9-10: 20-25 kg/hand back-off. Upper end only when scapular control is perfect.
Neutral grip, 1-second pause. Submaximal secondary press (stay 2-3 reps shy of failure). Sub: Neutral-Grip DB Bench 3x8.
Medium grip. Reduced ROM removes deep-elbow-flex range; protects medial tendon. Pause triceps on floor each rep. Min 2 min rest in Wks 7-10.
Medium grip, 2-second chest pause. Bench-specific without extra triceps/elbow stress. Min 2 min rest.
Maintenance only. Stop 2-3 reps shy of failure.
Compression-Goal Rule (Friday). Active toe lift, lift hips off floor with straight legs. Quality over quantity.
Best L-Sit variation, target 8-15 s. Adds to Friday Pike Pulses for compression total ~5 min.
Lower-intensity technique row, RPE 5-6. Warm up 5-10 min easy + dynamic mobility. Cool down 3 min easy. Sub Bike or SkiErg if elbow/knee not 100%.
Per Tuesday/Thursday rowing-schedule table for the week. Stay consistent on splits. Cool down 3 min easy.
Phase 2 Tuesday: 1,000 m / interval work, RPE 7-8. Sits 72 h before Friday squats.
10/side - anti-rotation hold each rep
Slow eccentric. Knee/hamstring support.
Anchor upper back, grip bench edge behind head. Stop rule: lower back arches or ribs flare = rep done. Never train to failure.
If 6 s is clean, add 1 slow negative.
5-count eccentric, tuck back to start. Stop well before shaking.
External rotation at top of pull
Vertical press stays light and clean. +10-15 kg Wks 1-8, +5-10 kg Wk 9. Full reach, ribs down, smooth arc. Skip if symptoms elevated.
Slow - ankle/knee stability, goose-foot management
Lateral trunk stability
Light - rotator cuff endurance
Tuck only - no German hang yet. Stop any sharp impingement.
Hold 2 s in partial German hang.
Full Skin-the-Cat with full German hang.
Slow descent, perfect knee tracking. Unilateral stability slot.
